author: maryannlupus
title: Legit works
content: I’m always skeptical of these kinds of apps, but this one truely does pay out! I typically get between $0.18 to $0.65 or so a day when I’ve put in a few hours playing games and completing the daily tasks. There are a lot of ads, and you definitely need to watch the ads offered during game play to activate or grab bonus coins, as well as deal with frequent “ad breaks”. I personally like playing the games while watching TV so o have something to watch while the ads play. The big secret is that while some ads run the full version of the ad, more than half of the ads can be skipped through by watching for the small X or fast-forward symbol that shows up after a few seconds. My favorite part about this app is that it pays out. It won’t make you rich, and you do have to wait until it offers you the cash out option every four hours, but if will hold your coins for you and then pay you quickly when you do cash out. I use PayPal and it has always shown up in my account within a minute or so. I have been testing out a bunch of different apps that claim to pay you for playing games or doing surveys, and PlayTest Pro by BestPlay is my favorite one. It’s reliable and fun if you can let yourself accept the frequent ads. And unlike every survey app I’ve tried, there are no issues with a task not paying out. The survey apps I’ve tried can get you to a higher total quicker, but they also screen you out of surveys or kick you out halfway through. This app doesn’t do that kind of thing. Just complete the daily tasks, then play whatever game you like best, skip through as many ads as you can, and get paid every four hours. The smaller payouts add up, and are a lot less frustrating than getting kicked out of half the surveys you try to complete.
